title: Per-variant proteome vs baseline (log-log) + Schmidt/Wisniewski r
interpretation: The least-discriminating axis: every variant hugs the baseline proteome diagonal and the validation correlation stays flat (Schmidt r 0.70-0.74, Wisniewski ~0.61). ppgpp-off shows the most scatter (Schmidt 0.696). Uses the corrected SET monomer_counts listener (#185).
command: scripts/render_variant_comparison.py: 8 cross-variant comparison analyses (v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/) over .pbg/runs/showcase4-variants/showcase4_variants parquet (5-variant x 2-seed sweep); variant_metadata {0:baseline,1:ppgpp-off,2:dnaA-2x,3:elong-down,4:media-succinate}; Altair->PNG/SVG via vl_convert.
